service_profile.service_outcome: Produce an evidence-led institutional equity research assessment and standardized report package for a publicly listed company.

separate_library_when: functionality is substantial and reusable across services
it requires an independent release and maintenance lifecycle

supported_patterns: MCP tools when available and authorized
integration_requirements.access_policy: The host/orchestrator must verify source availability, licensing, user and organizational entitlements, and permissions for each invocation.

output_contract.consistency_policy: Required sections, calculation definitions, source provenance, report parameters and acceptance checks remain stable across compatible models. Qualitative judgments follow documented evidence and decision criteria and disclose material uncertainty.

model_portability.target: Compatible Agent Skills hosts and models
model_portability.guarantee: Standardized service contract and deliverable requirements, not identical model reasoning or prose.

commercialization.note: The package defines a service capability; hosted execution, licensed data, enterprise entitlements, support, pricing and service-level commitments require separate operational and commercial arrangements.

runtime_requirements.python: required for included deterministic calculation and document-generation modules; not required to read the methodology
runtime_requirements.network: required only for live external data retrieval
runtime_requirements.external_data_access: authorized provider, API, MCP server, browser or user-supplied dataset
runtime_requirements.file_generation: requires the relevant libraries and a writable runtime

data_dependencies.name: Issuer filings and market prices
data_dependencies.freshness: Verify retrieval timestamp, filing date and reporting period for every invocation

evaluation.environment: Python 3.13.18; persistent remote Jupyter workbench; pytest and synthetic CLI smoke test
evaluation.report_ref: 43 tests passed. Synthetic CLI smoke test generated HTML, XLSX, DOCX, PPTX and a verification manifest; every artifact was checked for existence and non-zero size.
limitations: Automated tests do not establish financial-domain accuracy, point-in-time integrity, non-US issuer integration or production suitability.
SEC adapter retrieves raw Company Facts and filters by filing date; it is not a universal normalized financial-statement provider.
evaluation.scope: Complete local test suite (43 passed, 0 failed) and synthetic end-to-end CLI smoke test on Python 3.13.18. No claim of financial-domain accuracy, production suitability or cross-model portability.
